seo.title: Gap Down Explained: How a Stock Drops 40% With Zero Trades
seo.description: Your stock closed at fifty and opened at thirty — and nobody traded a single share in between. Overnight the market is shut, so sell orders just queue with no buyer to meet them. At the open an auction matches every queued order at one clearing price. That single print is the gap down, and the chart simply skips the space. #Shorts #Stocks #StockMarket #Investing
